focus: The newsroom can publish again. It had gone quiet for five days because it gave up after the first story it could not read, instead of trying the next one; it now works down the list and stops asking a publisher that has already refused it. The site also shows how long a product link has been unverifiable, and when it last definitely worked, without ever calling an unverifiable link broken.
nextStep: Confirm the newsroom resumes on its own schedule and publishes a new edition unattended, then widen the check that is meant to catch unreachable safety tests so this class of gap cannot hide again. Account verification remains on its separate approval path.

decisions.note: Expose a small deterministic mobile cohort and re-check close mix.
Refresh RUM UX ingestion before treating zero or low conversion as visitor behaviour.
Flip strict only after field p75 is sufficient and healthy.
Route top themes into feedback decision board lanes.
